meta.title: Anime Graph
meta.description: 3D anime map with an AI taste engine

fit.title: Is it for you?
fit.signInTeaser: Sign in and we'll tell you how well it fits your taste →
fit.dropTooltip: You tend to drop similar ones: {list}

onboardingCta.headline: Bring your list over — 30 seconds, and we'll tell you who you are as a viewer
onboardingCta.body: A MAL or AniList import carries over every score and status, and the AI writes your taste profile right away. Your old list stays intact.

auth.forgotHint: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
auth.resetHint: Choose a new password. Saving signs the account out on every other device.
auth.forgotSent: If that account exists, we have sent the link.
auth.termsPrefix: By creating an account you accept the
auth.termsSuffix: . Your written reviews are processed by an external AI provider.

leaderboard.heading: The highest rated titles
leaderboard.hintOwn: Our own ratings, Bayesian average, from at least two raters.
leaderboard.hintAnilist: AniList average score across the whole catalogue.
leaderboard.hintPopular: How many of us added it to a list.
leaderboard.emptyOwn: Not enough in-house ratings yet. Rate some titles and the list will build.

push.unsupported: This browser does not support web push.

home.heroResume: Pick up where you left off
home.fitTooltip: How well it fits your taste
home.fitTooltipLocal: How well it fits your taste (local estimate)
home.noMatchText: No title matches the filters you set. Loosen the taste threshold, or drop the genre filter.

opinions.heading: Waiting for a review
opinions.lead: Write a few sentences about what worked and what didn't — the AI pulls taste facts out of it, and every recommendation gets sharper.
opinions.emptyTitle: Every title of yours has a review 🎉
opinions.emptyText: When you finish something new, it will wait for you here.
opinions.placeholder: What did you like? What didn't work? What was the mood?

news.tourSeasonText: Every title of the current season — the badge shows how well it fits your taste. It works without a list too.
news.tourRecommendText: One button: the AI recommends based on the taste it learned from your list and your reviews. This is the point.
news.tourTonightText: Don't feel like deciding? It picks what to watch tonight based on mood and time.

seasonFilter.scoresUnavailable: AI score unavailable right now, sorted by airing time

catalog.sourceTitle: This adaptation is based on it
catalog.adaptationTitle: The anime was made from this

titleTour.fitText: A match calculated from your taste — with points for and against, and a warning if you tend to drop similar ones.
titleTour.opinionTitle: A review is the heart of the system
titleTour.opinionText: Write freely about what worked and what didn't — the AI pulls taste facts out of it, and every recommendation gets sharper.

addSearch.onYourListJump: On your list — jump to it on the graph

sync.heading: Two-way sync
sync.lead: No need to switch: connect your account, and whatever you set here (status, episode, score) updates on your MAL/AniList list too.
sync.connected: ✓ Account connected — your changes now sync automatically.

emailPrompt.saved: Saved. We sent a confirmation email — click the link inside it.
emailPrompt.noEmail: There is no email on your account, so you have no password reset.

profileReveal.heading: Who are you as a viewer?
profileReveal.failed: The portrait did not work this time (AI limit or an error) — you can retry any time on the Stats page.

characters.heading: Characters
characters.favouritesHint: — ♥ your favourites end up in the graph

profileSettings.bioPlaceholder: A few sentences about yourself — this shows on your public profile.
profileSettings.visibilityHint: Set to private, the /u/{username} page is unreachable. The text of your reviews is never public, regardless of this setting.

hierarchy.title: Hierarchy
hierarchy.viewTooltip: Auto: smaller covers without names when there are many anime (the name still shows on hover). Full: always a large cover + name. Dots only: fastest.

tonight.question: What mood are you in?
tonight.reason_resume: You are already at episode {progress} — one step closer to the end tonight.
tonight.reason_movie: A film — you can finish it tonight.
tonight.reason_comfort: You gave it {score}/10 — a guaranteed good evening, zero risk.
tonight.reason_longPlanned: It has been sitting on your plan list for a while — tonight is the night.
tonight.hint: Pick a mood and I'll roll one from your list.

graph.charactersTooltip: Favourite characters in the graph, cross-linked where the seiyuu matches
graph.staffTooltip: Directors in the graph — a shared director links your anime together
graph.tour1Text: The size of a genre bubble = how many anime you have in it. Click a bubble for the genre's anime, drag to rotate.
graph.tour2Text: Multi-level hierarchy (genre → studio → anime) with rearrangeable levels — if you want to dig deeper.
graph.tour3Text: WASD + Q/E: free flight through your own anime universe. Timeline mode sits in the bottom-right corner.

list.heading: My list
list.noMatchText: Nothing on your list matches this filter and search.

stats.noData: No data yet — add some anime on the graph.

owner.toSharedTooltip: Add to the shared “let's watch it together” list
owner.confirmRewatch: Rewatch it? Progress resets, the rewatch counter goes up.
owner.reviewPlaceholder: What did you like? What didn't work? Write freely — the AI pulls the taste facts out of it.
owner.finishPlaceholder: A couple of sentences: what worked, what didn't — this is what the recommender learns from.
